name: manual_a0981e
claim: Cancelling an asyncio task that awaits asyncio.to_thread or run_in_executor only stops the await: the thread keeps running and keeps holding its inputs. Accounting that releases a byte charge or queue slot in the awaiter's finally reports the resource free while it is in use. Shield the executor future, hand the release to its done-callback when the awaiter is cancelled, and make shutdown wait for outstanding thread calls inside its single deadline, reporting any that outlive it instead of presenting them as drained.

decisions.notes: oramasys PR 31 CodeRabbit Major, fixed in PR 36 on 2026-10-14: reproduced inflight bytes 367 to 0 while the thread was still running; four tests written first, red for the right reason.
